name: Neighbourhood Crime Rates
description: Reported crime counts and rates per 100,000 population by Toronto neighbourhood, broken down by offence type (assault, auto theft, break and enter, robbery, theft over, homicide, shooting) and year.

name: TTC Delay Data
description: TTC subway delay incidents including date, time, station, line, delay duration in minutes, gap, direction and the coded reason for each delay.

name: Parks & Recreation Facilities
description: Locations of Toronto parks and recreation facilities including pools, splash pads, rinks and amenities, with address and point geometry for mapping facilities near a location.

name: Building Permits
description: Active building permit applications in Toronto including permit type, status, work description, address, declared value and dates for construction and development activity.

name: Cycling Network
description: Toronto's cycling network infrastructure including bike lanes, cycle tracks, multi-use trails and sharrows, with installation year, street name and route geometry.

name: Dinesafe Restaurant Inspections
description: Toronto food premises inspection results under the Dinesafe program, including establishment name, address, inspection date, status (Pass/Conditional Pass/Closed), infraction details and severity.
